Class 12 Physics · Electromagnetic waves (the EM spectrum)
Physics, visualised #16

The whole spectrum, longest wave first (NCERT Table 8.1):
Radio: > 0.1 m · radio, TV
Microwave: 0.1 m – 1 mm · radar, ovens
Infrared: 1 mm – 700 nm · ?
Visible: 700 – 400 nm · what we see
Ultraviolet: 400 nm – 1 nm · sterilising
X-rays: 1 nm – 10⁻³ nm · bone scans
Gamma: < 10⁻³ nm · cancer therapy
Shorter wave, more energy.
